* What this is
"Everything org2html Renders" (=content/engineering/everything-org2html-renders.en.org=) and its
Spanish twin "Todo lo que org2html renderiza" (=…/todo-lo-que-org2html-renderiza.es.org=): one
page that exercises every Org construct org2html parses, from headings, tables and code to math,
embeds and includes. It is the page the article shell is refined against, and the page
=constructs.spec.js=, =article.spec.js=, =section-rail.spec.js= and =viewer.spec.js= open.

Everything the two posts pull in lives beside them, in the layout kyo-blog uses, so every
=#+INCLUDE: "../../includes/…"= resolves unchanged:

| Path        | Holds                                                                                  |
|-------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| =content/=  | the two posts                                                                          |
| =includes/= | =setup.org= (the SETUPFILE), =snippet.org=, =sample.js=, =kitchen-sink.{en,es}.org=, =kitchen-sink-lexer.js= |
| =media/=    | every image the posts name at =/blog/media/…=, the cover and hero included             |

It was copied byte for byte from kyo-blog on 2026-09-25. kyo-blog keeps its own copy as
publishable content; this one is the site's test copy of record and does not follow it.

* Using it
| Command                        | What you get                                                                  |
|--------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| =npm run preview:kitchen-sink= | the site built with ONLY this fixture (2 posts, EN and ES), served on :4173   |
| =npm run preview:no-articles=  | the site built with no blog at all (the empty manifest), served on :4173      |
| =npm run build=                | back to the real corpus from =../kyo-blog/dist=                               |

=node scripts/blog-mode.mjs <kitchen-sink|no-articles> [--serve] [--port N]= is the script
behind both. It renders with the local engine first (=ORG2HTML_BIN=, then
=../org-2-html/dist/cli/index.mjs=, then kyo-blog's installed package), builds the manifest with
kyo-blog's =ci/generate-manifest.mjs= (=KYO_BLOG_DIR=, default =../kyo-blog=), and puts
=public/sitemap.xml= back as it was once the build ends.

* Editing it
- Edit the posts here. The engine derives the slug from =#+TITLE=, so a retitle moves the URL
  every spec targets; =check-blog-fixture= names the title it expects.
- Two includes splice exact line ranges (=:lines "3-9"= of =kitchen-sink-lexer.js=), which is
  why =tests/fixtures/**= is outside ESLint: a lint fix would change what the page renders.
- An image a post names at =/blog/media/<file>= has to exist in =media/=.

* Never delete it
This is the only versioned copy of the page. Two guards stand in front of it:
- =scripts/check-blog-fixture.mjs= runs in =npm run precheck=, which the build, Shipwright and
  CI all run. A missing or emptied post, a changed title, or an include or image that no longer
  resolves fails it.
- The CI Protected Files job lists both posts under "Test Fixture", so a PR that touches or
  deletes them says so in a comment.
